title: NSClientV3: xDrip+ is not receiving data from AAPS (only BG values)
symptom: When switching to the new NSClientV3 plugin, xDrip+ is no longer receiving data from AAPS, only BG values. Switching back to NSClientV1 will have data backfilled to xDrip+.
cause: The behavior was bound only to v1 nsclient.
fix: Check all sync settings (xDrip+ Plugin, NSClientV3). Especially the setting NSClientV3 > Advanced Settings > Enable local Broadcasts was crucial for the communication with xDrip+. After reenabling it, xDrip+ receives all data.
settings_changed: NSClientV3 > Advanced Settings > Enable local Broadcasts → enabled
evidence_quote: Especially the setting NSClientV3 > Advanced Settings > Enable local Broadcasts was crucial for the communication with xDrip+. Now everything works as before: Even with the latest dev version, xDrip+ receives all data!
